# YAMP 0.8.1 — first public release

YAMP is a multi-source music player for Android, built for car head units and Android Auto as much as for the
phone. It started as a hard fork of [Yandex Music Lite](https://github.com/KorenskoyR/YandexMusicLite) and is no
longer the same app: upstream plays one service; YAMP plays your own music first and keeps Yandex Music as one
optional source.

This is the first release from this repository and supersedes the earlier 0.1–0.8 builds.

## Sources and accounts

- **This device** — folders on the phone, an SD card or a USB stick. Tags (ID3, Vorbis, MP4, old Russian CP1251),
  embedded covers or a cover file; MP3, AAC/M4A, FLAC, Opus, Vorbis and WAV. A drive that is out stays in the
  Library, dimmed: nothing is deleted, the queue skips its tracks and continues when the drive returns. Rescans by
  itself after start, on a mount and once a day, reading only changed files.
- **Jellyfin** — your own server, signed in with a password or Quick Connect. Each server and user is its own
  account with its own queues and cache. Library, folders (breadcrumbs, filter, pins, play a whole folder),
  favourites, playlists and search together with the other sources. Quality is per account: files Android plays are
  streamed as they are, the rest is converted (MP3, or FLAC for ALAC) and played from one full-speed download, so
  seeking works. Favourites can be downloaded for offline playback, plays are reported to the server, and the last
  visit stays readable when the server cannot be reached.
- **Yandex Music** — the optional source, added later from Settings → Accounts. My Wave, likes, playlists, radios
  and search.
- Several accounts at once, with one account order for the Library, the head unit, Android Auto and the queues.
  Queues can be grouped by account or shown as one flat list; signing out hides an account's queues and signing
  back in restores them.

## Queues

- Several independent, persistent queues, each bound to one account: create, rename, switch; every queue keeps its
  position, also after a restart.
- The queue panel shows Previous, Now playing and Up next; it opens at Now playing and follows the pull gesture.
- History of played tracks, app-wide.
- The playing queue is the one Android Auto and the car's queue switcher show.

## Library and search

- Home follows the active queue and shows the source's rows (recently added, pinned folders, favourites).
- Library has a section per signed-in account, each with its own rows, including downloaded tracks.
- Album and artist menus: Play now, Play next, Add to end, Add to queue…, Add to playlist…, and Start radio.
- Search covers every signed-in source at once, with a badge per result.
- Folder browsing with breadcrumbs, a filter on every level, natural sort and pinned folders.

## Player

- One player structure on every screen: queue dropdown and ⋮ on top; search, sleep timer, add to playlist, quality
  and wave/radio actions inside ⋮.
- Transitions in Settings → Playback, each with `0` = off: crossfade or “fade then rise”, plus separate start/pause
  and seek durations.
- A tapped track keeps the current one playing until it is ready, then switches; several quick skips land on the
  last one chosen.
- Like by gestures if wanted: double tap the cover to like, hold to dislike, with Undo.
- Swipe up opens the queue, swipe down closes the queue first and then the player.
- Next tracks: one card, or three with title and artist; the next track is prepared and cached ahead.
- On-disk stream cache shared by every source, plus a growing file for streams that arrive without a length.
- Offline: a fully cached track plays without network, after a restart too, for every account.

## Car, head unit and Android Auto

- A car layout that is first-class next to the phone: a full-height cover, the next tracks under it, the clock in
  the corner, large controls, and the queue panel over the player.
- Left- or right-hand drive: the layout mirrors the steering-wheel side.
- One layout for phones, landscape, split screen and car screens, from small head units to very wide ones.
- The car library: albums, playlists, liked/favourites and folders, with large buttons and a car-sized “Add to
  queue…”.
- Android Auto: every signed-in account has its own folder and the current queue; search covers every account.

## Radio

- My Wave and radio stations; start a radio from a track, album or artist, into a new queue or re-seeding an
  existing one; keep several radios at once, and “Keep” retains a radio's history.
- FM stations in the Radio source, with loudness levelling.
- Station feedback (likes and skips) and play reporting follow the provider.

## First run, widgets and updates

- First run offers **This device** and **Jellyfin**; Yandex Music is added later from Settings → Accounts.
- Home-screen widgets: «Строка» (4×1), «Плеер» (4×2) and «Обложка» (2×2) — the current track with cover, controls,
  like/dislike and progress, all showing the same state.
- The mini player keeps its proportions at any system font size.
- The app updates itself from this repository's releases.

## Settings and diagnostics

- Quality per account for unmetered and metered networks; account order; playback, player and appearance settings.
- A playback journal records the audio format, output, timings and settings, and shares as a file.
- A main-thread watchdog writes the UI thread's stack to the journal when it is blocked for 4 s or more.

## Notes

- The Yandex Music integration is unofficial: it uses the official app's client id and request signing and may
  break when Yandex changes its API. It needs a Yandex account with an active Yandex Plus; YAMP does not sell,
  resell or unlock anything.
- Android Auto: YAMP is installed outside Google Play, so enable “Unknown sources” in Android Auto's developer
  settings to see it.
